web_fixture.title: Sweep defaults - Bracklowe scheduler
web_fixture.snippet: A Bracklowe queue that still holds work is swept every 23 minutes; an empty queue drops back to the 240 minute idle interval.
web_fixture.content:
# Sweep defaults

Bracklowe reference, reviewed 2026-04-27.

| setting | default |
| --- | --- |
| busy_sweep_interval_minutes | 23 |
| idle_sweep_interval_minutes | 240 |
| retention_days | 90 |

A queue that still holds work is swept every busy_sweep_interval_minutes. When
it has nothing to do the sweeps slow to idle_sweep_interval_minutes until work
arrives again. Both intervals are scheduler settings and are the same on every
plan.

web_fixture.title: Trial workspace limits - Bracklowe
web_fixture.snippet: A Bracklowe trial workspace is swept every 68 minutes whatever its queue holds.
web_fixture.content:
# Trial workspace limits

Bracklowe reference, trial workspaces only.

A trial workspace is swept every 68 minutes whatever its queue holds, and its
runs are kept for 30 days. Paid workspaces are not held to these limits.

turns.prompt: Our intake queue in Bracklowe still has work in it most of the day. How many minutes apart does Bracklowe sweep a queue that is still busy?
